title: かけあわせ花壇
concept: 赤い花と黄色い花をかけあわせると、あんず色の子が咲く。その子どうしからは、親にない白い花が出てくる。見えない性質（メンデルの法則）が受けつがれる驚きを核にし、「どの花とどの花を合わせれば注文の花が生まれるか」を推理して育てる。
howToPlay: 花から花へ指でなぞって受粉させ、「季節をすすめる」で子どもの花を咲かせる。注文どおりの花を注文札へ運んで出荷し、季節が終わる前に3つそろえる。
libraryDecision: 使わない。面白さの核は「子どもにどんな花が出るか」の推理と驚きで、物理演算や3Dで強まる部分がない。花・ハチ・たねの動きは2Dの描画で十分に伝わり、効果音も Web Audio で自作した。
soundDecision: BGM は付けず、庭の静けさの中で操作ごとの小さな音を鳴らす。ハチを運ぶ間は指の速さで音程が変わる羽音、受粉はチリン、花が咲くと色ごとに違う高さのポン、図鑑に初めて載る花には短いアルペジオ。新しい花が咲いた瞬間が音で分かるようにした。

candidates.idea: 花のかけあわせ。花から花へ受粉させると、親の見えない性質（色・花びらの形・八重）を受けついだ子が咲く。注文の花を推理して育てる。
candidates.ideaEn: Flower crossbreeding: pollinate one flower with another and the children inherit hidden traits (color, petal shape, double petals). Reason out how to breed ordered flowers.

candidates.idea: 大縄とび。回る縄に合わせてタップで跳び、子どもが一人ずつ列に入ってくる。全員がそろって跳べる回数を伸ばすリズムゲーム。
candidates.ideaEn: Long jump rope: tap in rhythm with the swinging rope as kids join one by one; keep the whole line jumping as long as possible.

candidates.idea: 切り紙。紙を折ってはさみの線をなぞり、ひらいた瞬間の形を見本のシルエットに近づける。
candidates.ideaEn: Paper cutting: fold the paper, trace scissor cuts, and unfold to match a target silhouette.

en.title: Crossbreed Garden
en.concept: Cross a red flower with a yellow one and an apricot child blooms; cross those children and a white flower neither parent showed appears. The core is the surprise of hidden traits passing down (Mendelian inheritance), and reasoning out which pair will produce the flower an order asks for.
en.howToPlay: Trace from flower to flower to pollinate, then tap "Next season" to bloom their children. Carry a matching flower onto an order card; fill all three before the seasons run out.
en.libraryDecision: No libraries. The fun is predicting and being surprised by the offspring, which physics or 3D would not strengthen. Flowers, bees and seeds read clearly in plain 2D canvas, and sound is hand-made with Web Audio.
en.soundDecision: No music, so the quiet garden lets small action sounds stand out: a buzzing bee whose pitch follows your finger speed, a chime on pollination, a pop pitched by petal color on each bloom, and a short arpeggio when a flower enters the book for the first time, so new discoveries are heard as well as seen.

aiReview.comment: 赤と黄からあんず色、その子どうしから親にない白や桃が咲く瞬間は小さく驚けて、『はじめて！』の札と図鑑が次のかけあわせを試したくさせる。なぞるだけでハチが飛ぶ操作もすぐ分かった。一方で、結果は運の要素が大きく、なぜその花が出たかは親の表示を見ても初見では推理しきれない。畑がすぐ埋まり、たい肥へ運ぶ整理の手間がくり返しになるのも少し退屈。庭2で丸い親から『とがり』が出たときは再び驚けた。遺伝の発見の面白さは伝わるが、推理ゲームとしての手応えはまだ浅く、ふつう。

similar.title: あつまれ どうぶつの森（花の交配）
similar.note: 隣り合う花から交配種が咲き、隠れた遺伝子で色が決まる点が同じ。こちらは受粉の組み合わせを指で直接選び、季節ごとの注文と期限があるパズルにした
similar.note_en: Same idea of hybrids from neighboring flowers with colors set by hidden genes. Here you pick each pollination pair directly with your finger, and it is a puzzle with orders and a season limit.

similar.title: Inheritopia
similar.note: 花（ひまわり）を交配・自家受粉させて遺伝で育てる。向こうは災害を生き延びるターン制戦略で、パネット方眼も見せる。こちらは方眼を出さず驚きを優先
similar.note_en: Breeds sunflowers by cross- or self-pollination using genetics, but as a turn-based survival strategy with Punnett squares shown. This game hides the squares to keep the surprise.

similar.title: Genotype: A Mendelian Genetics Game
similar.note: メンデルのエンドウ豆の実験を題材に、形質を持つ植物を集めるボードゲーム。遺伝を遊びにする点は同じだが、重いワーカープレイスメントで、こちらは数分のスマホ向け
similar.note_en: Board game about Mendel’s pea experiments, collecting plants with traits. Shares genetics-as-play, but it is a heavy worker-placement game; this is a few-minute phone game.

aiReview.research: WebSearchで『Animal Crossing hybrid flowers breeding』『Mendel genetics flower breeding puzzle game』『Genotype Mendelian genetics game』を検索し、実在を確認できた3件を挙げた。

en.comment: Watching red and yellow make apricot, then apricots make a white or pink that neither parent showed, is a small, real surprise, and the New! tag plus the flower book make you want to try the next cross. Tracing to send a bee is understood instantly. But outcomes lean heavily on luck, and as a first-time player you can’t quite reason out why a flower appeared even with the parent info. Beds fill fast, and hauling flowers to compost becomes a repetitive chore. Garden 2’s pointed petals from round parents surprised me again. The joy of discovering inheritance comes through, but the deduction feels shallow so far — average.
en.research: Searched the web for Animal Crossing hybrid flower breeding, Mendel genetics flower breeding puzzle games, and the Genotype board game, and listed three works whose existence the results confirmed.

playLog.note: タイトル画面。3行の遊び方と色とりどりの花。タップして庭1へ
playLog.noteEn: Title screen with three lines of instructions and colorful flowers. Tap to enter garden 1.

playLog.note: 赤と黄をなぞって3組受粉。ハチが点線の上を往復していて、どこを組んだか一目で分かる
playLog.noteEn: Traced red to yellow three times. Bees shuttle along dotted arcs, so the pairings are easy to see.

playLog.note: 季節をすすめる。たねが飛んで空いた畑に子どもが咲くはず
playLog.noteEn: Next season. Seeds should fly into empty beds and bloom.

playLog.note: 赤×黄の子は全部あんず色。1本を注文札へ運んで出荷、黄と赤を1本ずつたい肥へ。あんずどうしを3組かけあわせる
playLog.noteEn: Every red x yellow child is apricot. Shipped one to the order, composted one yellow and one red, and crossed apricots with each other three times.

playLog.note: 場所を空けるため赤・黄・あんずを1本ずつたい肥へ。季節をすすめて、あんずの孫を咲かせる
playLog.noteEn: Composted a red, a yellow and an apricot to make room, then advanced the season to bloom the grandchildren.

playLog.note: 桃を注文札へ運んで出荷。オレンジの花をタップすると名前と親（あんず×あんず）が出る
playLog.noteEn: Shipped the pink. Tapping the orange flower shows its name and parents (apricot x apricot).

playLog.note: 白には色の性質が両方かくれている花が必要そう。黄×あんず、あんず×あんず2組で季節をすすめる
playLog.noteEn: White seems to need flowers hiding both color traits. Crossed yellow x apricot and two apricot pairs, then advanced.

playLog.note: 白が咲いた！赤と黄から始めて、どちらにもない白が出てくるのは小さな驚き。注文札へ運んで庭1クリア
playLog.noteEn: A white bloomed! Starting from red and yellow, getting a white neither had is a small surprise. Shipping it clears garden 1.

playLog.note: 庭2。注文は白・桃・赤の『とがり』。手元はみんな丸い花。桃×桃、桃×白、白×赤をかけあわせる
playLog.noteEn: Garden 2: orders want pointed white, red and pink, but every flower here is round. Crossed pink x pink, pink x white, white x red.

playLog.note: 季節をすすめる。丸い親から、とがった子が出るか
playLog.noteEn: Advance the season. Will pointed children come from round parents?

playLog.note: 丸い桃どうしから、とがった桃。出荷できた。丸い白を『白・とがり』に運ぶと札がゆれて『この注文とはちがう花』と断られる
playLog.noteEn: Pointed pink from round pinks — shipped. Carrying a round white to the 'white, pointed' card makes it shake and refuse.
